objective: Close the two M556 P1 findings without changing the frozen PBR4/A1 workload, service, resource or decision gates. This r4 is source-only: it replaces the ambiguous common terminal row with one architecture-independent mutually-exclusive terminal FSM and replaces the circular future authorization rule with a constructible one-way runner/review/authorization/post-authorization-wrapper chain.

normative_import_and_replacement.precedence: contract-r4 > contract-r3 > contract-r2 > M534-r4 > M534-r3 > M534-r2
normative_import_and_replacement.import_rule: Every r3 byte and recursively imported semantic remains normative unless and only unless an r4 replacement path below names it. Missing predecessor, SHA mismatch, weakening, merge-by-implementation or local reinterpretation fails before result/attempt creation.
replacement_paths_exact: cycle_machine_common.priority_table row with priority 2 guard/action only to exclude terminal-owned directory clear
normative_import_and_replacement.deletion_rule: The r3 priority-8 guard/action and the r3 future authorization rule have no residual force after this replacement. They may not be combined, unioned or selected at runtime.

preserved_frozen_identity.cohort: exact M511 H67 ep35 ConvTranspose S10, four layers, literal T10
preserved_frozen_identity.strongest_A1: one fixed minimum integer total-cycle A1 selected only after all three complete S10x4xT10; r3 tie order preserved

cycle_machine_common_r4_replacement.edge_semantics: At cycle start sample the entire prior state plus frozen input/response/sink transcript. Evaluate common priorities 0 through 9 in order, execute exactly one action, atomically apply exactly its listed state delta, and increment exactly one primary class. No free edge exists.

priority_2_replacement.guard: shared external or dense-output FSM, or a non-terminal imported directory FSM, has an enabled mandatory next microedge; terminal_directory_clear_active is false
priority_2_replacement.action: Execute exactly that imported non-terminal microedge; if blocked hold all payload and charge its named link/latency/port stall; no source, frontier, context, group or terminal action

cycle_machine_common_r4_replacement.priorities_0_1_3_4_5_6_7_9: Imported byte-exact from r3 and unchanged.

priority_8_replacement.action: Execute the unique first true row of terminal_fsm_r4. No architecture-specific transition, source/bundle/frontier accept, service, external microedge or second terminal row may share this edge.

cycle_machine_common_r4_replacement.terminal_owned_directory_exclusion: When terminal_state is DIRECTORY_CLEAR_START, DIRECTORY_CLEAR_WORD or DIRECTORY_CLEAR_END, common priority 2 is false for this directory operation. Exactly terminal priority 8 owns the global directory port and charges it.
cycle_machine_common_r4_replacement.cycle_conservation: total_cycles equals the integer sum of all mutually exclusive imported and terminal primary classes

all_required: canonical current-output-block source transcript is exhausted
all matching source/bundle descriptors and frontier tokens were accepted and retired exactly once
all architecture ingress, context, active_service, L4 response, O8, pending-write and release_pending state for this block is empty
no external-link, restore, refill, output beat, zero-build or non-terminal directory work for this block is pending
all dense 384-byte destinations belonging to this block are committed exactly once
the block-qualified owner and commit counts match the exact ledger
exact_current_block_close_predicate.last_block_additional_required: For output_block==last_output_block(layer), committed-block bitmap equals all output blocks of the current sample/layer/time and no earlier block has unretired work.
exact_current_block_close_predicate.mismatch: sticky fault with zero close, clear, owner or performance credit

terminal_fsm_r4.scope: One common architecture-independent FSM is used byte-identically by A1-SC8, A1-ISO8, A1-OSG and PBR4. Architecture tables cannot override, bypass or add a terminal edge.

ordered_rows.state_delta: freeze and hash current block commit receipt; set terminal_state=NEXT_BLOCK_OWNER_LOAD; owner is invalid and no block index changes on this edge
increment output_block by exactly one; install its empty block-qualified owner and counters; set terminal_state=ACTIVE_BLOCK
freeze and hash last-block receipt plus complete committed-block bitmap; invalidate block owner; set terminal_state=DIRECTORY_CLEAR_START
acquire the global 1RW directory port exclusively; set clear_index=0 and clear_write_count=0; set terminal_state=DIRECTORY_CLEAR_WORD; perform no word write on this edge
issue and accept exactly one zero write to directory word clear_index; increment clear_write_count and clear_index by one; retain exclusive directory ownership and DIRECTORY_CLEAR_WORD state
issue and accept exactly one zero write to directory word 1023; set clear_write_count=1024; retain clear_index=1023; set terminal_state=DIRECTORY_CLEAR_END
verify the exact 1024-word zero-write identity/count hash, release the directory port, clear directory epoch-valid state, set terminal_state=TIME_RETIRE
freeze current time receipt; set terminal_state=NEXT_TIME_OWNER_LOAD; sample/layer/time/output_block identities do not change on this edge
increment time by exactly one; set output_block=0; install the empty next-time block owner/counters; set terminal_state=ACTIVE_BLOCK
freeze the literal-T10 time receipt; set terminal_state=LAYER_RETIRE; identities do not change on this edge
verify all ten time receipts and freeze the layer receipt; if layer<3 set terminal_state=NEXT_LAYER_OWNER_LOAD else set terminal_state=SAMPLE_RETIRE
increment layer by exactly one; set time=0 and output_block=0; install its empty owner/counters; set terminal_state=ACTIVE_BLOCK
verify all four layer receipts and freeze the sample receipt; if sample_id<9 set terminal_state=NEXT_SAMPLE_OWNER_LOAD else set terminal_state=COHORT_RETIRE
increment sample_id by exactly one; set layer=0,time=0,output_block=0; reset the prescribed per-sample-layer-time xorshift transcript; install empty owner/counters; set terminal_state=ACTIVE_BLOCK
verify and freeze exact S10x4xT10 architecture receipt; set terminal_state=POINT_COMPLETE and mark this immutable architecture point complete; no further cycle for this point is legal

mutual_exclusion_proof_obligations: T00 and T02 are disjoint by output_block<last versus ==last
T04 and T05 are disjoint by clear_index<1023 versus ==1023
T07 and T09 are disjoint by time<9 versus ==9
every other row has a distinct terminal_state or disjoint terminal counter guard
exactly one row is true whenever priority 8 is selected
undefined, repeated, skipped, multirow or wrong-class edge is transition_undefined_mismatch and sticky fault with zero useful credit
same_edge_forbidden: nonlast retire and next-block owner load

golden_cycle_schedules_r4.encoding: Each canonical_json_utf8 string is hashed as its exact UTF-8 byte string with no trailing newline. The run-length pair count is charged cycles, and DIRECTORY_CLEAR_WORD_INDEX_0_THROUGH_1023 expands to 1024 distinct ascending accepted writes.
golden_cycle_schedules_r4.architecture_sharing: Both r4 terminal goldens are common and mandatory for all four exact architectures; each architecture must reproduce the identical event labels, counts, state deltas and primary classes.
golden_cycle_schedules_r4.mismatch_policy: Any architecture-specific difference, alternative expansion, free edge, same-edge fusion, word-order change, cycle-count change or SHA mismatch fails before candidate visibility. These goldens are semantic regressions, not measured performance.

identity_direction: r4 contract and r4 source hammer
immutable runner sources and runner static hammer
canonical post-review authorization JSON plus member and outer seals
one wrapper-mediated invocation of the immutable runner
future_launch_closed_identity_schema_r4.runner_rule: Immutable runner source contains only the canonical authorization path, never the later authorization member/manifest/seal SHA. At runtime it independently parses strict JSON, verifies canonical authorization member and outer seals, rehashes every authorization-bound runner/review/input identity, verifies its own source SHA equals the value in authorization, and rejects direct invocation without wrapper attestation.
future_launch_closed_identity_schema_r4.authorization_rule: Authorization is authored only after immutable runner, runner-static, candidate and final-release review bytes exist. It binds those earlier bytes and result/attempt absence, has no self-hash or wrapper field, and is independently member-hashed and outer-sealed at the canonical path.
future_launch_closed_identity_schema_r4.wrapper_rule: A later immutable launcher wrapper freezes the exact authorization JSON/member-sidecar/outer-seal SHA plus immutable runner SHA. The wrapper is then independently reviewed and double-sealed. The wrapper contains the canonical wrapper-review path but not that later review SHA; at launch it rehashes its own source against the reviewed value, verifies the review manifest/outer seal and authorization chain, then passes a read-only canonical authorization descriptor to the runner.
future_launch_closed_identity_schema_r4.wrapper_review_rule: The post-authorization wrapper review binds wrapper SHA, authorization triple, runner SHA, contract/runner/candidate/final-review identities and result/attempt absence. Its PASS-and-launch_now predicate is the terminal release; no later author-generated permit or hash back-edge is allowed.
